issue_title: URL encoded route parameters not handled correctly
problem_statement: In chi router, URL-encoded path segments (such as encoded slashes %2F or encoded parentheses %28%29) are not matched correctly because the routing tree matches against r.URL.Path instead of r.URL.EscapedPath(). Using EscapedPath() preserves encoded characters during route matching, and parameters should be unescaped using url.PathUnescape when retrieved.
system_instruction: You are a core maintainer of go-chi/chi. Fix open issue #641 regarding URL encoded route parameters. All necessary file content and test logs are provided above. Do not invoke any further tools. Output ONLY the git unified diff patch (diff --git a/mux.go b/mux.go) and a Go test function.
